title: TriageSim: A Conversational Emergency Triage Simulation Framework from Structured Electronic Health Records
abstract: arXiv:2603.10035v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Research in emergency triage is restricted to structured electronic health records (EHR) due to regulatory constraints on nurse-patient interactions. We introduce TriageSim, a simulation framework for generating persona-conditioned triage conversations from structured records. TriageSim enables multi-turn nurse-patient interactions with explicit control over disfluency and decision behaviour, producing a corpus of ~800 synthetic transcripts and corresponding audio. We use a combination of automated analysis for linguistic, behavioural and acoustic fidelity alongside manual evaluation for medical fidelity using a random subset of 50 conversations. The utility of the generated corpus is examined via conversational triage classification. We observe modest agreement for acuity levels across three modalities: generated synthetic text, ASR transcripts, and direct audio inputs. We provide the code for TriageSim at https://github.com/dipanka

translated_title: TriageSim：一种基于结构化电子健康记录的会话式急诊分诊模拟框架
translated_abstract: 急诊分诊研究因对护士与患者互动的监管限制，仅限于使用结构化电子健康记录（EHR）。我们引入了TriageSim，一个从结构化记录生成个性化分诊对话的模拟框架。TriageSim支持多轮护士与患者互动，并明确控制语言不流畅性和决策行为，生成了约800份合成转录文本及相应音频。我们结合自动化分析（针对语言、行为和声学保真度）与人工评估（针对医学保真度，使用50个随机对话子集）来验证效果。通过会话式分诊分类检验了生成语料库的实用性。我们观察到在三种模态（生成的合成文本、自动语音识别转录和直接音频输入）中，紧急程度分级的一致性适中。我们在https://github.com/dipanka提供了TriageSim的代码。
tldr: TriageSim创新性地从结构化电子健康记录生成可控的个性化分诊对话，并验证了其在多模态分诊分类中的实用性。
en_tdlr: TriageSim innovatively generates controllable persona-conditioned triage conversations from structured EHRs, demonstrating utility in multimodal triage classification.
